substeps.html: When trying to return to Thorgel, using the Underground Pass is slower (about three minutes instead of two and a half) but there is no risk of being stuck if the mirror is facing the wrong direction. Teleport to the Tirannwn lodestone and then make your way to the cave. From there climb down the well, and go through the big doors. Then you can walk south to the stairs down to the dwarf camp where Klank is. Once in the dwarf camp, there are stairs on the south wall leading down to Thorgel and the entrance to the death altar.
substeps.text: When trying to return to Thorgel, using the Underground Pass is slower (about three minutes instead of two and a half) but there is no risk of being stuck if the mirror is facing the wrong direction. Teleport to the Tirannwn lodestone and then make your way to the cave. From there climb down the well, and go through the big doors. Then you can walk south to the stairs down to the dwarf camp where Klank is. Once in the dwarf camp, there are stairs on the south wall leading down to Thorgel and the entrance to the death altar.

substeps.html: If you intend to use this method to return instead of returning through the Mourner Headquarters entrance and running through Temple of Light, ensure the beam cast by mirror #14 is focused on the final pillar instead of the light door. You will need to be able to reenter the temple to complete the steps below once the talisman has been obtained.
